description: Header file defining the MACAddress class for handling MAC addresses, including parsing, comparison, and string conversion.

classes.name: MACAddress
classes.description: Class representing a MAC address with parsing, validation, and string conversion functionalities.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the MAC address to a colon-separated hexadecimal string.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the MAC address is valid (not all 0xFF).

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes input string to determine its format (hex, delimited, base64).

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts input string to MAC address byte array based on detected format.
